uncertainties.note: Continuation of the same unnamed Berkt-unit pilot from the previous slice (see batch_06683.json uncertainty); pronoun "her" again rests on feminine speech particles, not a name.
"he/his" in Barrel's musing refers to Berkt, who is named explicitly just before (06749-06758) and just after (06768); read as continuing that thread rather than the enemy pilot he was just fighting.

This line addresses Akito by surname alone (テンカワ) rather than by first name/full name as most of the scene does; kept as "Tenkawa" rather than normalized to "Akito" to preserve that shift, which may signal a colder or more formal speaker.
"Captain Hoshino" assumes this is Ruri Hoshino (locked as Nadesico B/C captain); rank placed before the tagged surname to match the precedent in batch_01073 ("Lieutenant Commander Hoshino").

"Gekko" (月光号) is locked in meeting_terms_015.json, but that entry's cited source is the Eureka Seven wiki's Gekkostate ship, while this row is a Nadesico-side scene; flagging the source mismatch for the orchestrator even though the spelling itself is followed as locked.
"Yurika" is used to match existing corpus usage (proposals_dialogue_00776.json), presumed to be Yurika Misumaru; not independently re-researched in this pass.
